# Marcus Results

> Paid advertising agency for Australian outdoor home services trades. Based in Brisbane, QLD. Founded 2021.

Marcus Results runs targeted paid ad campaigns (Meta, Google, Local Service Ads) exclusively for Australian home services businesses that work on the outside of homes — landscapers, house washers, concreters, roofers, tree services, exterior painters, fencers, and pavers. The agency qualifies and filters leads before they reach the client, so tradespeople only receive calls from buyers who are ready to book.

## What makes Marcus Results different

- Specialises exclusively in outdoor home services — no cafes, SaaS, or e-commerce
- Includes lead qualification and booking automation in every package (not just ads)
- Month-to-month contracts only — no lock-ins
- Turns down approximately 60% of enquiries to maintain quality
- Launched in 2021 by Marcus, whose father is a Brisbane concreter

## Proven results

- $2.4M booked for clients in 12 months
- 47 clients scaled across 14 industries
- 11× best client return on ad spend (ROAS)
- $2.40 average cost per qualified lead
- 14-day average time from signed contract to live campaigns

## Services

All packages include custom landing pages, lead qualification system, and booking flow automation.

- **Paid Ads** — Meta + Google + Local Service Ads. From $2,000/month management fee plus ad spend.
- **Starter package** — $2,000/month. 1 ad channel, landing page, lead qualifier, weekly reports.
- **Growth package** — $3,500/month. Multi-channel ads, custom landing pages, lead qualifier, booking flow, weekly and monthly strategy.
- **Scale package** — $6,000+/month. Everything in Growth plus multi-location targeting, brand refresh, dedicated strategist.

Minimum ad spend: $2,000/month across all packages.

## Industries served

Landscaping, house washing, concreting, roofing, tree services, exterior painting, fencing, paving. Other outdoor home services considered on enquiry.

## Areas served

Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Ipswich — and Australia-wide.
